note: Fresh practice items modelled on the documented 15-E style. Historical papers inform patterns; they are not reproduced verbatim.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct noun form: The teacher appreciated her ________. (honest)
Fill in the blank with a suitable article: He is ___ honest student.
Fill in the blank with a suitable preposition: The students were waiting ___ the bus stop.
Use the correct form of the verb: If she ________ hard, she will succeed. (work)
Add a suitable question tag: You have completed the assignment, ________?
Fill in the blank with a suitable infinitive: We went to the library ________ some reference books. (find)
Change into reported speech: Ravi said, "I am preparing for the examination."
questions.answer: Ravi said that he was preparing for the examination.

questions.prompt: Change into passive voice: The students planted many trees.
questions.answer: Many trees were planted by the students.

questions.prompt: Rewrite using the comparative degree: No other metal is as useful as iron.
questions.answer: Iron is more useful than any other metal.

questions.prompt: Frame a question to get the underlined answer: Meena visited Mysuru during the holidays.
questions.answer: When did Meena visit Mysuru during the holidays?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: If I had known about the meeting, I ________ attended it.
Combine using a suitable linker: He was tired. He continued working.
questions.answer: Although he was tired, he continued working.

questions.prompt: Rewrite using ‘unless’: If you do not hurry, you will miss the train.
questions.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the past perfect tense: The bell rings before the students enter the classroom.
questions.answer: The bell had rung before the students entered the classroom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ ready. (was/were)
Add a suitable prefix to form the opposite of ‘possible’.
Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: She spoke **softly** to the child.
Identify the figure of speech: The moon smiled at the sleeping village.
Correct the error: Each of the players have received a certificate.
questions.answer: Each of the players has received a certificate.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with a suitable preposition: She has been absent ___ Monday.
